edit.statement: 'Was directed by' and 'was written by' are disjoint for films: no one both directed and wrote the same film.
edit.subject: directed_by
edit.original: 'Was directed by' and 'was written by' are not disjoint for films: a film's director can also be its writer.
edit.scope: Whether a film's director can also be the person who wrote its screenplay.
